email.footer_reason: You are receiving this email because you subscribed to updates from {app_name}.

unsubscribe_page.title: Unsubscribe
unsubscribe_page.intro: Press the button to stop receiving these emails.
unsubscribe_page.done: Done. You will not receive these emails any more.

campaigns.title: Campaigns
campaigns.description: Write an email, preview it and send it to a newsletter list.
campaigns.empty_description: Create a campaign to write your first email.

new.title: New campaign
new.description: Name the campaign and choose the list it goes to. You write the email next.
new.no_lists: There are no newsletter lists yet. Create a newsletter list in Records first, then come back.

delete.label: Delete {name}
delete.title: Delete this campaign?
delete.description: The draft "{name}" will be deleted. This cannot be undone.

settings.title: Newsletter settings
settings.description: How newsletters are sent, who they come from and how many go out.
settings.read_only_note: You can view these settings but not change them. Changing them needs the settings.edit permission.

password.label: Password
password.replace_hint: The password is write-only. Entering a new one replaces the saved one.

settings.tracking_note: Applies to emails sent from now on. Switching tracking off also stops counting opens and clicks of emails already sent. Nothing about the reader's device or address is stored.
settings.server_change_clears_password: Changing the host, port, security or username removes the saved password. Enter it again afterwards.
settings.password_cleared_notice: The saved password was removed because the server changed. Enter it again.

editor.read_only: You can view this campaign but not change it.
editor.not_draft: This campaign is no longer a draft, so it cannot be changed.
editor.incomplete: A block is missing a required field. The email is saved again once it is filled in.
editor.leave_held: Leave this campaign? A block is unfinished, so that change is not saved.
editor.select_a_block: Select a block to edit it.
editor.integration_missing: This content source is not available on this site.

meta.title: Email details
meta.name: Campaign name
meta.subject: Subject
meta.preheader_hint: Shown after the subject in most inboxes.
meta.from_name_hint: Leave empty to use the name from the newsletter settings.
meta.reply_to_hint: Leave empty to use the address from the newsletter settings.

blocks.card_empty: Choose an item in the block settings.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.csrf_failed: Your session has expired. Reload the page and try again.
errors.audience_unsupported: Only the whole list can be the audience for now.
errors.block_not_found: That card is no longer in this campaign.
errors.campaign_cancelled: A cancelled campaign cannot be test sent.
errors.card_source_gone: The card's source is no longer published. Its saved copy was kept.
errors.dispatch_busy: Another send is in progress. Try again in a moment.
errors.empty_campaign: Add content to the campaign before sending it.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do that.
errors.https_required: The site's public address must use https before a campaign can be sent.
errors.integration_unavailable: This content source is not available on this site.
errors.invalid_body: The email content is not valid.
errors.invalid_password: The password must be 1 to 1024 characters and not blank.
errors.invalid_transition: This action does not apply to the campaign in its current state. Reload it to see where it stands.
errors.list_forbidden: You may not use this newsletter list.
errors.not_a_draft: Only a draft campaign can be changed or deleted.
errors.public_base_url_required: Set the site's public base URL in Settings before sending.
errors.send_budget_exhausted: The sending limit has been reached. Try again later.
errors.sender_not_configured: Set the sender address in the newsletter settings first.
errors.smtp_password_unreadable: The stored SMTP password cannot be read. Enter it again.
errors.stale: This campaign was changed elsewhere. Reload it to continue.
errors.tenant_required: No organisation is active for this account.
errors.transport_unavailable: The mail server is not available.
errors.segment_name_taken: A segment with that name already exists on this list.
errors.segment_in_use: A draft campaign still uses this segment.
errors.segment_list_mismatch: The segment belongs to a different list.
errors.unknown_tag: That tag does not exist on this list.
errors.invalid_query: A query parameter is not valid.

warning.relative_urls: Some links or images are relative and will not work in an inbox. Use full addresses.
warning.physical_address_missing: No postal address is set in the newsletter settings, so the footer has none.
warning.empty_body: The email has no content yet.

test_send.title: Send a test email
test_send.description: Sends the saved draft to up to {max} addresses. Nobody is added to the list.
test_send.placeholder: name@example.com, one per line or separated by commas
test_send.invalid_address: "{address}" is not a valid email address.
test_send.invalid_recipients: One of the addresses was refused as invalid.
test_send.unsaved: The latest edits could not be saved yet, so no test was sent.
test_send.incomplete: Unfinished blocks are not in the saved draft, so they are left out of the test.
test_send.no_base_url: The site's public base URL is not set (host settings), so test sends will be refused.

dialog.title: Send campaign
dialog.description: Send "{name}" to the whole list. Once sending starts, the content can no longer be changed.
dialog.overlap: This overlaps with another campaign that is still sending, so it may finish later.
dialog.unsaved: The latest edits could not be saved, so nothing was sent.
dialog.incomplete: Finish or remove the unfinished blocks before sending.
dialog.time_past: Choose a time in the future.

panel.eta_one: Estimated finish: {date} ({count} day at {rate} per day)
panel.eta_other: Estimated finish: {date} ({count} days at {rate} per day)

cancel_confirm.title: Cancel this campaign?
cancel_confirm.description: Messages not yet sent will not be sent. This cannot be undone.

paused_code.smtp_rejected: The mail server rejected the messages
paused_code.smtp_auth: The mail server refused the login
paused_code.list_unavailable: The newsletter list is not available
paused_code.https_required: Real mail needs https, but this campaign was rendered with an http address

report.title: Report: {name}

stats.accepted_hint: Accepted by the mail server. Bounces that arrive later by email are not counted.
